column1: # Every campaign the paper's results rest on, to be re-run against the fixed
# mesher (inclusions built as ellipsoids, not bounding spheres).
#   name    deck (under params/)    outdir    deck glob    results file    postprocess script    extra env
# Order matters only in that cheap campaigns come first, so a systematic
# problem shows up in minutes rather than after the expensive ones have run.
# The validation campaign is first and the chain stops if it fails.
# Not listed, and deliberately: rve_eringen_homog is the phi=0 control and
# contains no inclusions at all, so the mesher fix cannot change it. It is
# re-run anyway (it is six cells) to keep the whole of 4.3.1 on one build.
# Case study 3: the Novik Bay cantilever beams of Gogolaze et al. (2026).
# Appended 2026-08-06. Twelve slices on their measured brine profile at one
# brine partition, plus the partition sweep at the base that sets the error bar.
